edges.en: Walk straight 15 meters. Reception is ahead.
edges.hi: Seedha 15 meter chaliye. Reception aage hai.

edges.en: Turn left. The pharmacy is 10 meters ahead.
edges.hi: Left mudiye. Pharmacy 10 meter aage hai.

edges.en: Walk straight 20 meters to the main junction.
edges.hi: Seedha 20 meter chaliye, main junction aayega.

edges.en: Turn left. The cafeteria is 10 meters ahead.
edges.hi: Left mudiye. Cafeteria 10 meter aage hai.

edges.en: Turn right. The pathology lab is 12 meters ahead.
edges.hi: Right mudiye. Pathology lab 12 meter aage hai.

edges.en: Walk straight 20 meters. The lift is on your right.
edges.hi: Seedha 20 meter chaliye. Lift aapke right side par hai.

edges.en: Turn left. The washroom is 10 meters ahead.
edges.hi: Left mudiye. Washroom 10 meter aage hai.

edges.en: Turn right. X-ray is 12 meters ahead.
edges.hi: Right mudiye. X-ray 12 meter aage hai.

edges.en: Walk straight 18 meters. The east exit is ahead.
edges.hi: Seedha 18 meter chaliye. East exit aage hai.

edges.en: Take the lift to the second floor.
edges.hi: Lift se second floor par jaiye.

edges.en: Exit the lift and turn left. Walk 20 meters.
edges.hi: Lift se bahar nikal kar left mudiye. 20 meter chaliye.

edges.en: Exit the lift and walk straight 18 meters. Billing is ahead.
edges.hi: Lift se bahar nikal kar seedha 18 meter chaliye. Billing aage hai.

edges.en: Walk straight 20 meters. Cardiology is ahead.
edges.hi: Seedha 20 meter chaliye. Cardiology aage hai.

edges.en: Turn right. The department is 10 meters ahead.
edges.hi: Right mudiye. Department 10 meter aage hai.

edges.en: Turn left. The ENT clinic is 12 meters ahead.
edges.hi: Left mudiye. ENT clinic 12 meter aage hai.

ophthalmology.en: You have reached the Ophthalmology Department. The registration counter is on your left.
ophthalmology.hi: Aap ophthalmology department mein pahunch gaye hain. Registration counter aapke left side par hai.

cardiology.en: You have reached Cardiology. The counter is straight ahead.
cardiology.hi: Aap cardiology mein pahunch gaye hain. Counter seedha aage hai.

ent.en: You have reached the ENT Clinic. The counter is on your right.
ent.hi: Aap ENT clinic mein pahunch gaye hain. Counter aapke right side par hai.

pharmacy.en: You have reached the Pharmacy. The counter is straight ahead.
pharmacy.hi: Aap pharmacy par pahunch gaye hain. Counter seedha aage hai.

reception.hi: Aap reception par pahunch gaye hain.

receptionScript.disclosure: Hello, this is Sahayak, an AI assistant speaking on behalf of a  visitor.
receptionScript.question: Could you tell me the route from the main entrance to the {dest}?
receptionScript.mockReply: Take the lift on the right side of the main corridor to the second floor, turn left, then follow the signs. It is a short walk from the lift.

summary.en: Reception confirms: take the lift to the second floor, turn left, then follow the signs.
summary.hi: Reception ne bataya: lift se second floor par jaiye, left mudiye, phir signs follow kijiye.
